name: Chat: computer offline
what: A chat whose computer is asleep says "<computer> is offline. Wake it, or get a model here." above the composer, with Try again and Choose model or Get a model (was Text "—" with no reason).
steps: Pair the phone with a computer and choose one of its text models in a chat.
Sleep or quit Off Grid AI on the computer.
Open that chat on the phone and look above the composer.

name: Chat: no model
what: A new chat with no model says "Needs a chat model." with Choose model (a model is on the phone) or Get a model (opens Models, Text tab).
steps: Have no model chosen (eject every model from the Models sheet).
Chats > New and look at the centre card.

name: Models sheet: chat line
what: The Models sheet shows the chat model's line at the top (computer offline, or no model) with its step.
steps: With the computer asleep (as above), Home > tap the model chip to open the Models sheet.

name: Gallery: no image model
what: Gallery with no images and no image model says "Needs an image model." with Get a model (opens Models, Image tab).
steps: Have no image model and no generated images.
Home > Gallery.

name: Voice mode: no speech model
what: Voice mode's big Tap to speak says "Needs a speech model." with Get a model, and the tap opens Models (Transcription tab) instead of doing nothing.
steps: Have no speech (Whisper) model downloaded; Pro on.
Chats > New > switch to Voice mode and look under Tap to speak.

name: Chat: no model
what: With no chat model the composer shows a Get a model chip (opens Models, Text); the sidebar dot says No model and opens Models; a send that fails says "No chat model yet." with Get a model (was a dead bubble asking to finish onboarding).
steps: Remove every text model in Models.
Open Chat and look at the composer and the sidebar dot.
Send a message.

name: Chat: Image and Video with no model
what: Image and Video (chip and + menu) open Models on the Image or Video tab when no model is there; the menu items stay, dimmed, with a reason (were greyed with no word, or turned on a dead mode).
steps: Have no image model.
Open Chat, click Image, then + > Generate image.

name: Chat: mic with no speech model
what: The mic error names the real reason (No speech model yet) with Get a speech model (was a generic Check Settings line).
steps: Remove every transcription model.
Open Chat and record with the mic.

name: Guide: Open Images
what: Open Images starts chat in image mode, or opens Models on Image when no image model is there (was a plain chat).
steps: Open the Guide, Images topic, click Open Images.

name: Meetings: no speech model
what: Beside Record: Needs a speech model. Get a model. A failed transcription keeps that reason with its step; a failed summary says why with Try again, never a cut of the transcript.
steps: Remove every transcription model.
Open Meetings and look beside Record; record a short meeting.

name: Dictation: what is missing
what: One line per missing piece: speech model (Get a model), microphone (Allow / Open Settings), shortcut in use (Change shortcut), Accessibility for hold (Open Settings); the header says Tap when hold cannot work.
steps: Remove every transcription model, or turn microphone access off.
Open Dictation.

name: Send model: failure and empty list
what: A failed model send says one plain line (Pixel already has this model. Open Models there…); the empty list says No models here can run on <device> yet (was raw engine text and an OGAM jargon line).
steps: Sync > a paired phone > Send model; send one the phone already has.
